[RDSC.4a.4] **Schema and rule cross-references.** `AlphaNode` atoms
reference schemas by `schema_name`; `TerminalNode` atoms reference rules
by `rule_name`. Both are resolved against atoms already
registered from `Slot` / `SchemaLogical` / `SchemaTtl` (schemas) and `RuleCooldown`
(rules). `AlphaNode` and `TerminalNode` atoms carry no duplicate
declarations of schema structure or rule metadata.
